rationale.intuition:
Regression lock for PR #295 hasEarlyAction schema drift: Pomona College is ED-only (ED1 + ED2). It does NOT offer Early Action. Pre-fix, the engine fell through to the heuristic EA branch (×1.30) when a user picked EA at Pomona, silently inflating the prediction by 30% with no underlying CDS data to support the boost. The fix added `hasEarlyAction === false` short-circuit in roundMultiplier (returns neutral, treated as RD).

This fixture asserts EA at Pomona produces a probability within ±3 percentage points of RD. If the delta jumps to ~+5pp or more, the bug has regressed — either the hasEarlyAction guard was removed, or Pomona's row got hasEarlyAction=true (incorrectly).

sources.name: Pomona Admissions — Paths to Apply
sources.evidence: Pomona offers Early Decision I (Nov 15) and Early Decision II (Jan 8) — both binding — plus Regular Decision. No non-binding Early Action plan exists.

sources.name: apps/api/prisma/seeds/backfill-has-ea-ed2.ts HAS_EA_FALSE list
sources.evidence: Pomona is explicitly enumerated in the hasEarlyAction=false backfill list alongside the other ED-only T20 LACs (Williams, Swarthmore, Amherst, Bowdoin, Wellesley, Middlebury, etc.).

sources.name: PR #295 — hasEarlyAction schema drift fix
sources.evidence: Pre-fix: EA at Pomona returned ×1.30 boost using the flat EA heuristic, equivalent to fabricating a ~9% EA admit rate. Post-fix: roundMultiplier early-exits to neutral when hasEarlyAction === false.

sources.name: Pomona CDS 2024-25 Section C21
sources.evidence: Combined ED admit rate ~16% reported; no EA section because no EA plan exists.
